then.u_message:
A broken throwing-knife hilt lies among torn equipment. A hand has worn the wood smooth; a dark thread remains at the broken end.

You recognize it. Judeau noticed others' needs before they asked. Now there is nothing left to ask him.

else.u_message:
A broken throwing-knife hilt lies among torn equipment. A hand has worn the wood smooth; a dark thread remains at the broken end.

The name "Judeau" means nothing to you yet. A person died here; you do not yet know his life.
You have already examined this place. What you learned is saved.

then.u_message:
A large fighter's body remains beside a narrow passage. Nearby lies a heavy clasp torn from shattered armor. Fresh scratches cross old hammer marks.

Pippin rarely wasted words. Beside him, you seldom needed to ask whether he would cover your back.

A broken fragment of scabbard lies beside the body. The former owner's fingers polished the leather; ash is caught in a split seam.

You remember his voice, his irritation, his arguments. Memory brings back a living person, not convenient words about a fallen comrade.

then.u_message:
Needles and scraps from a crushed sewing kit are scattered beneath a dented breastplate. Small, neat repairs survived among rough tears.

Gaston spoke of life after the war. You recognize his sewing kit and remember how earnestly he made those plans.

effect.u_message: A torn cover hangs from the ruined cart. Beneath it lie a waterskin, bread and blood-stained dressings. Claws have scored the baggage; scraping comes from the other side of the fold. Behind you the broad ash trail continues south.

The footprints scatter where pale cords cross the ground. A sharper trail follows them out of the northern hollow. Low tangles lie ahead; a white outcrop breaks the view to the west, where firmer ground continues south.

The dead have been dragged into the hollows between the folds. Broken shields lie above them, useless now. Wet tearing comes from behind the raised flesh; at the eastern edge, an unbroken strip of ground winds past the feast.
Beyond the pale ribs, a motionless figure watches the slaughter. The air is heavy; even the creatures fall silent near him.
We broke the shields to make a wall. Held the gap until the wounded had passed. There is no road back. Keep the pale trail in sight. The great ribs bend toward the gathering.
